title: OmniGrab: logo-led redesign
question: Keep the soft video-sleeve direction, choose the task-strip alternative, or steer it. All options preserve your logo palette and existing download capabilities.

options.label: Soft video sleeves
options.thesis: A friendly, logo-led video utility with one clear path from source to saved file.
options.viewport: OmniGrab and the supplied mascot above the current tab; rounded video sleeves with quality and a full-width Download MP4 action; a compact download queue below.
options.risk: The mascot must stay small enough to leave the task in view.

raised.raise: Pair every state color with a readable label.
Use one alignment rhythm for media facts and controls.
Keep one memorable brand moment and clear source names.
Keep technical annotations in readable details, separate from the main action.

options.label: Step-by-step task strip
options.thesis: A compact task-first popup that separates finding, choosing and saving.
options.viewport: The mascot sits beside a three-step task strip; video choices and the download queue follow in a tightly aligned list.
options.case: Strong task clarity, with a more procedural and less playful first impression.
options.risk: A fixed task strip consumes space in a small popup.

options.label: State rail
options.thesis: A rail-led interface with formal state marks.
options.viewport: Applied only where the task stays recognizable.
options.case: Tiny legends and a technical topology weaken the everyday downloading task.
options.risk: Tiny legends and a technical topology weaken the everyday downloading task.

options.label: Grid specimen
options.thesis: A strict, visible grid organizes every element.
options.viewport: Applied only where the task stays recognizable.
options.case: Constructed type and visible grids compete with the supplied organic logo.
options.risk: Constructed type and visible grids compete with the supplied organic logo.
options.kept: Consistent alignment across facts and controls.

options.label: Coded catalog
options.thesis: A numbered catalog with a strong single identity.
options.viewport: Applied only where the task stays recognizable.
options.case: Coded names obscure the video the user is saving.
options.risk: Coded names obscure the video the user is saving.
options.kept: One memorable brand moment, with source names kept clear.

options.label: Mascot collection
options.thesis: A playful gallery of mascot-led items.
options.viewport: Applied only where the task stays recognizable.
options.case: Repeated characters could be mistaken for actual video artwork and crowd a narrow popup.
options.risk: Repeated characters could be mistaken for actual video artwork and crowd a narrow popup.
options.kept: Reserve the supplied mascot for the brand and helpful empty states.

options.label: Annotated reference
options.thesis: A precise reference layout separates facts and annotations.
options.viewport: Applied only where the task stays recognizable.
options.case: Small type and dense annotation suit diagnosis better than everyday downloading.
options.risk: Small type and dense annotation suit diagnosis better than everyday downloading.
options.kept: Technical evidence remains available in clear details.

canonCard.label: Familiar browser utility
canonCard.thesis: A conventional utility layout with OmniGrab branding.
canonCard.viewport: A compact header, source list and download queue.
canonCard.risk: Less distinctive beside other video utilities.
